title: Definitions Entry — Which Lateness Charges Count against a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan
content:
# Definitions Entry — Which Lateness Charges Count against a Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

**The lateness charges that count against the plan**, when a further lateness on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan is being priced, are read from the plan's billing history in one of three ways.

1. Where the plan stands past due at the handling date, every lateness charge booked inside the stretch counts, whether or not a give-back stands against it.
2. Where the plan stands active at the handling date and automatic payment is in force on it, no earlier lateness charge counts at all.
3. In every other case, only the lateness charges booked inside the stretch that no give-back answers count.

## The difference the standing makes

| What the billing history holds inside the stretch | Past due | Active with automatic payment | Any other case |
|---|---|---|---|
| Two lateness charges, neither answered by a give-back | Two count | None counts | Two count |
| Two lateness charges, one answered by a give-back | Two count | None counts | One counts |
| Two lateness charges, both answered by give-backs | Two count | None counts | None counts |
| No lateness charge at all | None counts | None counts | None counts |

Under the third way, a give-back booked inside the stretch answers a lateness charge booked inside the same stretch, and the count never falls below none.
